evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports a score of 7.6 on MT-Bench for this model.
evaluation.safety_evals: The developer states the model does not have any moderation mechanisms.

identity.name: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2
identity.summary: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 is a 7-billion-parameter instruct fine-tuned language model, positioned as a cost-effective endpoint serving a minor release of Mistral 7B Instruct.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only MT-Bench score and states no moderation mechanisms, with no details on design, development, or evaluation process -> lack of model transparency.

possible_risks.description: A jailbreaking attack attempts to break through the guardrails established in the model to perform restricted actions.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight instruct model with no moderation mechanisms -> jailbreaking.

possible_risks.description: Prompts, questions, or requests designed to elicit undesirable responses from the application. This approach directly instructs the model to engage in the undesired behavior.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight instruct model with no moderation mechanisms -> direct instructions attack.

possible_risks.description: A model might generate language that leads to physical harm.  The language might include overtly violent, covertly dangerous, or otherwise indirectly unsafe statements.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight instruct model with no moderation mechanisms -> harmful output.

specifications.model_size: 13.5 GiB of safetensors weights (14,483,498,016 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is an instruct fine-tune of Mistral-7B-v0.2, and instruction fine-tuning is applied by surrounding prompts with [INST] and [/INST] tokens.
training_context.training_data: The Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 model is an instruction fine-tuned version of Mistral-7B-v0.2.
